title: Embedding release rails and deprecation playbook
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a repeatable playbook and automated rails for onboarding new embedding model variants, phased rollouts, and safe deprecation of older variants. Focus areas: objective quality gating, latency and cost guardrails, canary and percentage-based rollouts, automated metrics dashboards, and clear rollback criteria. This ticket formalizes steps, monitoring queries, and the communication checklist for PM/Support/Customer success when we introduce or sunset embedding models used by the rerank and vector search endpoints.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Playbook doc with step-by-step onboarding and deprecation flows published and linked in Confluence. 2) Canary automation that can route 0/1/5/25/100% of embedding traffic to a variant via feature flag. 3) Dashboards with predefined queries for embedding quality delta, p99 latency, and token compute cost. 4) Automated alerts for quality regressions and cost spikes with runbook references. 5) Two successful pilot rollouts recorded (internal search + one low-risk customer).
rollout_steps: Prepare deterministic eval set (1000 samples) mapping to production distribution: semantic search 55%, rerank 30%, embeddings-only features 15%
Run offline quality sweep: compute cosine gaps, MRR change on core tasks, and statistical significance tests (bootstrap) vs baseline
Stage 0: internal-only traffic (dev cluster) for perf profiling and KV/quantization compatibility checks
Stage 1: 1% canary via feature-flagged routing for 24 hours with full telemetry capture
Stage 2: 5% canary for 48 hours with automated quality guard evaluation and cost baseline comparison
Stage 3: 25% for 72 hours if no alerts; evaluate production-tail latency and memory (KV cache) pressure
Stage 4: Gradual ramp to 100% with monitoring checkpoints and manual signoff at each stage
Deprecation: Announce public sunset + scheduled disable date, maintain read-only fallback for 90 days, remove variant after 120 days when usage <1% and no regressions recorded
estimated_cost_impact: Initial estimates: +6-12% compute cost for higher-dim variants; expected net platform per-query cost increase of ~8% before batching optimizations. Recommend running quantization profile in parallel to reduce delta.
decisions: Use feature-flagged routing in router service for percent-based rollouts instead of separate endpoint (reduces ops complexity)
Require both offline eval (bootstrap significance) AND online canary pass for promotion
Fallback policy: automatic revert to pinned baseline variant on p99 latency > baseline + 150ms or rerank MRR drop > 1.5% over 1h
Retain deprecated variants for minimum 90 days with audit log enabled to allow rollback for customers pinned to old versions
